correctness.rationale: PASS: For the Ising wheel W_n=K_1 join C_n with J>0,h>0,n>=5, exact flip energies are 2J s(a-M) at the hub and 2J x_i(a-s-x_{i-1}-x_{i+1}) at the rim. Their nonnegative inequalities are necessary/sufficient even at ties. The s=+1 small-field words are cyclic maximal independent sets counted by Perrin P_n; s=-1 is their spin reversal with two even alternating words excluded by hub magnetization. At a=1, hub -1 gives Lucas L_n-2 epsilon_n; hub +1 counts cyclic words with no triples, positive magnetization cutoff Q_n. At 1<a<3, isolated negatives, run lengths and M cutoff give polynomial parity cases; at a=3 independent-set binomials give the boundary row; at a>=n hub flip determines 1,2,1 state counts. Entropies log plastic constant, log golden ratio, 0 follow automata and bounded polynomial counts. Independent direct brute force checked all nine sampled fields at n=5..11 (63 exact cases); it does not prove all n.
residual_risks: At resonant fields weak minima admit neutral flips and need not absorb a tie-accepting Glauber chain.
Entropy limits hold for fixed a=h/J, not a growing with n.
